title: West Oz Mate
style: Aussie outback kanga pop phonk with half-volume emotional peak: dusty cowbell loops, distorted 808s, chopped vocal chops, crunchy clap stacks, and a sliding sub-bass under a glitchy trap drum grid. Add didgeridoo drone, bush-guitar twangs, synth brass stabs, tape saturation, auto-tuned duet hooks, and wide stereo reverb.
